Build a Marketing Plan You Will Actually Use

Monday, November 16, 2026 (6:00 PM - 7:30 PM) (EST)

Description

When you’re running a business, marketing can easily become a long list of things you “should” be doing. ​This two-hour workshop with Letterpress Communications will help you cut through the noise and focus on what matters most: who you’re trying to reach, what you want to accomplish, what you need to say and where you need to show up. You'll identify audiences, goals, key messages and marketing channels, then map out a manageable 90-day marketing plan you can actually use.
